ns2:course.label: Graduate Level Organ
ns2:course.description: May be repeated to a maximum of 20 hours. Prerequisite: Selected studies from the masterworks of organ literature. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in music, or successful completion of a qualifying audition for appropriate faculty members of the Organ/Harpsichord Division.
